QuestInfo.0: Talk to Utah. He has some favors to ask before he introduces Evan to you. Totally not a problem for a hero like yourself.
QuestInfo.1: Utah is trying to gather materials to build a house back in his hometown. Go to #b#m100040200##k and hunt #b#o5150002##k monsters to get 70 #i4000671# items to build the columns for his house.
QuestInfo.2: You got 70 #i4000671# items for Utah's house.
